Dewing Less Campaign

Dallas, TX / 202428 photographs
About the project

For FITISH’s Fall 2024 beauty launch, we created a visually rich campaign titled “Dewing It At Night”, blending bold skincare visuals with a relaxed, nighttime aesthetic. Shot at Production House studio in Dallas, Texas, the project features close-up beauty and product imagery inspired by a girls-night-in concept.

With makeup by Kelsey and creative direction rooted in FITISH’s signature balance of chill and chic, the visuals highlight both the product’s glow and the lifestyle it represents. I led the project as both photographer and videographer, capturing stills and motion for multi-platform use.
